description: Deterministic physics and dimensional validation constraints for extracted catalog attributes.

rules.name: Positive Physical Quantities
rules.error_message: Physical metric must be strictly positive.

rules.name: Maximum Aspect Ratio Check
rules.error_message: Aspect ratio between length and width exceeds physically reasonable threshold (50:1).

rules.name: Steel Material Density Range
rules.error_message: Calculated density is outside the valid range for steel alloys (7.55 - 8.05 g/cm³).

rules.name: Operating Temperature Order
rules.error_message: Maximum operating temperature must be strictly greater than minimum operating temperature.

rules.name: Ohm's Law Sanity Check
rules.precondition: voltage is not None and current is not None and resistance is not None
rules.error_message: Voltage, current, and resistance conflict with Ohm's Law (V = I * R) by more than 5% margin.
